#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Verify the fix for the CRS units issue with compound CRS."""

from odc.geo.crs import CRS

# Test compound CRS similar to the BAG format issue
compound_crs_wkt = """COMPOUNDCRS["GDA94 / MGA zone 50 + Instantaneous Water Level Height",
PROJCRS["GDA94 / MGA zone 50",
    BASEGEOGCRS["GDA94",
        DATUM["Geocentric Datum of Australia 1994",
            ELLIPSOID["GRS 1980",6378137,298.257222101,
                LENGTHUNIT["metre",1]]],
        PRIMEM["Greenwich",0,
            ANGLEUNIT["degree",0.0174532925199433]],
        ID["EPSG",4283]],
    CONVERSION["UTM zone 50S",
        METHOD["Transverse Mercator",
            ID["EPSG",9807]],
        PARAMETER["Latitude of natural origin",0,
            ANGLEUNIT["degree",0.0174532925199433],
            ID["EPSG",8801]],
        PARAMETER["Longitude of natural origin",117,
            ANGLEUNIT["degree",0.0174532925199433],
            ID["EPSG",8802]],
        PARAMETER["Scale factor at natural origin",0.9996,
            SCALEUNIT["unity",1],
            ID["EPSG",8805]],
        PARAMETER["False easting",500000,
            LENGTHUNIT["metre",1],
            ID["EPSG",8806]],
        PARAMETER["False northing",10000000,
            LENGTHUNIT["metre",1],
            ID["EPSG",8807]]],
    CS[Cartesian,2],
        AXIS["easting",east,
            ORDER[1],
            LENGTHUNIT["metre",1]],
        AXIS["northing",north,
            ORDER[2],
            LENGTHUNIT["metre",1]],
    ID["EPSG",28350]],
VERTCRS["Instantaneous Water Level Height",
    VDATUM["Instantaneous Water Level"],
    CS[vertical,1],
        AXIS["up",up,
            LENGTHUNIT["metre",1]],
    ID["EPSG",5829]]]"""

crs = CRS(compound_crs_wkt)
print(f"CRS: {crs}")
print(f"Projected: {crs.projected}")
print(f"Geographic: {crs.geographic}")
print(f"Units: {crs.units}")

# Verify it returns expected 2-element tuple
assert isinstance(crs.units, tuple)
assert len(crs.units) == 2
assert crs.units == ("metre", "metre")
print("✓ Fix verified: units property correctly returns 2-element tuple")

arguments.summary: Fixed ValueError: too many values to unpack when inspecting GeoBox of compound CRS (like BAG format). The issue was in the CRS.units property which assumed exactly 2 axes when unpacking axis_info, but compound CRS can have 3+ axes (e.g., easting, northing, vertical). Modified the units property to safely handle compound CRS by taking the first two spatial axes.
